title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #5): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from VS Code parity with today's DONE JetBrains fixes, daemon tool-family gaps, and TROUBLESHOOTING/DEVELOPMENT docs drift
description:
Filed by the governor at 17:09Z on 2026-11-03. Hunts #2-#4 (task-2597ac6f, task-859eff80, task-130a6a5c) produced 15 rows today, and most were DONE within an hour of filing. A notification-only architect session can't run a hunt, so the hunt is a claimable row.

WHY. After hunt #4's three rows (56f77335, b5bfda4d, 0f2e958f) are claimed, about 5 coders are idle again with 0 claimable WORKING rows. The CQ-M07m/n wrapper chain stays serial (2 rows active, 6 gated on it).

LANE. Search, in this order of preference:
1. moe-vscode/src: VS Code parity with today's DONE JetBrains client fixes. JetBrains went first; check whether the VS Code extension has the same defect. Each row must cite the VS Code file:line that has it:
   - 37e03b91 (3b56ee35): a step's active amendment not shown in Plan Review / Task Detail;
   - 40813cc1 (a000b817): the settings view ignores worktreeMode in the landing/gate policy it shows;
   - e44a8daf (8be13403): the previous-arrow / Previous on a WORKING card asks the daemon for a move it refuses;
   - 475e8844: Clear on the Done column while a board search is active (the count shown vs what the daemon archives);
   - 6fe1e5ae: decision cards missing after a start or reconnect, because decisions are requested once before the connection opens.
   Already twinned, so skip: ac587df5 (its twin 5a5a7189 is in REVIEW), and the protected-launch twins d5eca150 and a6227f4e.
2. packages/moe-daemon/src: systematic gaps across a tool family, the way hunts #2 and #3 found the missing actor (c05bf92d), chat_decision's skipped sender and channel checks (314405bb) and the modifiedFiles cap (e3d41183). That means a family member that skips a guard, a fence, an actor or a validation its siblings apply.
3. docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md against the code: a documented command, flag, default, error string or fix that no longer matches. Cite the doc line and the code file:line.

Skip:
- scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/tests/postflight*, scripts/tests/parity-check.* (the CQ-M07 lane);
- packages/moe-proxy/README.md (56f77335), docs/SCHEMA.md (b5bfda4d), and the JetBrains release path MoeCommandSender.kt / MoeToolWindowPanel.kt (0f2e958f);
- the files 5a5a7189 holds in REVIEW: moe-vscode/src/panels/TaskDetailPanel.ts, moe-vscode/src/types/moe.ts, moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md and moe-vscode/tests/task-time-budget.test.cjs. A finding in one of them is still fine to file, but give it dependsOn task-5a5a7189;
- every other file an open row's plan holds. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves.
Already known, so don't re-file: TURBO auto-approve's "WORKING by unknown" line; the JetBrains board fingerprint omitting needsHumanReview; BoardMoves (not real: cards are draggable); the dead ▶ on BLOCKED cards (held until 0f2e958f lands); /ws broadcasts the plugins ignore but the 3 s full-state refresh masks (SETTINGS_UPDATED, RESOURCE_UPDATED).

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#4. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD 585fedc6 or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place. For VS Code tests, read mem:gotcha-vscode-tests-need-full-repo-snapshot first.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp.
- For client parity or wire drift: the daemon file:line that emits the shape and the client file:line that drops or misreads it.
- For docs drift: the doc line and the code file:line.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists. Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Prefer rows that QA can check with a unit test alone (vitest or the moe-vscode node tests).
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.
Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 585fedc6 or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or an emitter/consumer (or doc/code) file:line pair.

No filed row targets scripts/moe-agent.*, scripts/tests/postflight*, scripts/tests/parity-check.* or a file an open row's plan holds (per lanes.js at hunt time) without a dependsOn on that row. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
